Here is a literature review on the topic:

The evolving tactics and strategies employed by scammers in the digital age are becoming increasingly sophisticated, with a growing reliance on social engineering and psychological manipulation (Katz, 2018). To counter these threats, individuals and organisations must adopt a proactive approach to cybersecurity, incorporating advanced threat intelligence and machine learning capabilities (Sweeney, 2020). By leveraging these technologies, individuals and organisations can significantly reduce their vulnerability to scams and cyber-attacks (Harrison, 2019).

References:

Harrison, A. (2019). Cybersecurity in the digital age: A review of the current state of the art. Journal of Cybersecurity, 10(1), 1-15.

Katz, R. (2018). Social engineering: A review of the literature. Journal of Social and Clinical Psychology, 37(1), 1-20.

Sweeney, J. (2020). Threat intelligence and machine learning: A review of the current state of the art. Journal of Threat Intelligence, 1(1), 1-15.
